```{=html}
<style>
main#quarto-document-content > .panel-tabset > ul.nav-tabs {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1020;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

main#quarto-document-content > .panel-tabset > .tab-content .panel-tabset > ul.nav-tabs {
  position: sticky;
  top: var(--outer-tabs-height, 49px);
  z-index: 1010;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var outerTabset = document.querySelector("main#quarto-document-content > .panel-tabset");
  if (!outerTabset) return;
  var outerTabs = outerTabset.querySelector(":scope > ul.nav-tabs");
  if (!outerTabs) return;

  function updateStickyOffset() {
    var height = outerTabs.getBoundingClientRect().height;
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--outer-tabs-height", height + "px");
  }

  updateStickyOffset();
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
    new ResizeObserver(updateStickyOffset).observe(outerTabs);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", updateStickyOffset);

  outerTabs.querySelectorAll(":scope > li > a").forEach(function (tab) {
    tab.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", function () {
      var targetTop = outerTabset.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
      if (window.scrollY > targetTop) {
        window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetTop), behavior: "smooth" });
      }
    });
  });

  outerTabset.querySelectorAll(".tab-content .panel-tabset").forEach(function (innerTabset) {
    innerTabset.querySelectorAll(":scope > ul.nav-tabs > li > a").forEach(function (tab) {
      tab.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", function () {
        var outerHeight = outerTabs.getBoundingClientRect().height;
        var targetTop = innerTabset.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - outerHeight;
        if (window.scrollY > targetTop) {
          window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetTop), behavior: "smooth" });
        }
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
